summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report details ESG performance, including partnerships with First Nations, improved safety metrics, and GHG emissions intensity. No material transaction, corporate event, or special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. No deal terms are applicable.
